ask_wind/03_seagull.mp3.text: I come from where the clouds live,

ask_wind/06_seagull.mp3.text: Clouds are the sea in the sky. You cannot hold them.

ask_wind/07_narrator.mp3.text: The Sun rises, slow and warm.

clean_branch/03_narrator.mp3.text: At night, Taka's light stays on.

clean_branch/choices.mp3.text: A. Close your eyes and sleep. Or tell me your own idea.

climax/01_narrator.mp3.text: The Sun rises. It shines on Taka. It shines on the seagull.

climax/03_narrator.mp3.text: The Old Machine calls, weak and far.

climax/05_narrator.mp3.text: Taka looks at the surface. The wind is still here.

climax/07_seagull.mp3.text: You choose. I will not choose for you.

climax/08_narrator.mp3.text: Taka's light blinks. One. Two. Three.

climax/choices.mp3.text: You choose. A. Dive back to recharge. B. Listen one more minute.

codex/coral.science.mp3.text: Coral looks like stone, but it is actually a huge family of tiny animals.Each tiny animal is called a coral polyp, only the size of a sesame seed.Generation after generation, polyps live together and build hard little houses.A coral reef is home to so many sea animals.

codex/coral.taka.mp3.text: Coral is not stone. It is a house built by many little bugs. What I clean every day is their home.

codex/seagull.science.mp3.text: A seagull is a bird that loves living by the sea.It has big wings and can ride the wind for a long, long time.Seagulls are not picky eaters. Fish, little shrimp, shells . they eat them all.Its call is very loud, 'ah.ah.', like saying hello.

codex/seagull.taka.mp3.text: The seagull has wings. I do not. But I have a propeller.

dream/choices.mp3.text: Go up and see. Or tell me your own idea.

ending_a/03_narrator.mp3.text: Taka saves the wind song in the Memory Bank.

ending_a/04_narrator.mp3.text: The next day, Taka is full of power.

ending_a/05_narrator.mp3.text: Taka plays the song for the Old Machine.

ending_a/06_narrator.mp3.text: For the first time, the Old Machine's light blinks.

ending_b/06_narrator.mp3.text: Little by little, the seagull pushes Taka back down to the sea with big wings.

ending_b/09_narrator.mp3.text: But in Taka's Memory Bank, there is one finished wind song.

just_listen/03_narrator.mp3.text: The wind is so clear now.

just_listen/choices.mp3.text: Taka opens its eyes. The sun is up, big and round.

onboarding/voice-guide.mp3.text: I'm listening. Tap the microphone, or press and hold it. Talk to me.

prologue/02_narrator.mp3.text: Taka lives at the bottom of the sea.

prologue/03_narrator.mp3.text: Every day, Taka cleans the coral.

prologue/04_narrator.mp3.text: Every day, Taka listens to the Old Machine tell stories.

prologue/08_narrator.mp3.text: But today, Taka wants to go up.

start/01_narrator.mp3.text: The sea bottom is full of lights.

start/02_narrator.mp3.text: Taka cleans the coral in the shiny lights.

start/07_oldmachine.mp3.text: Do not go. There is no water up there.

start/choices.mp3.text: You choose. A. Swim up and see. B. Keep cleaning the coral. Or tell me your own idea.

surface/04_narrator.mp3.text: But Taka hears the sound clearly now.

surface/13_taka.mp3.text: I do not know. But I want to hear it all.

surface/choices.mp3.text: You choose. A. Ask the wind: Where do you come from?. B. Just listen. Or tell me your own idea.
